# Slice QE Gate

Use qe-orchestration and verification-engineer. Check requirement-to-test traceability, automated test results, integration/contract tests, relevant regression, static analysis, visual/accessibility/security/performance checks where applicable, unresolved defects, logs and evidence. Report mandatory blockers and residual risks. Gate can be PASS, BLOCKED or NEEDS APPROVAL. Do not advance or implement the next slice. Request human `ACCEPT SLICE <ID>`.
